The <b>Craw Summons</b> is an [[Items (Silksong)#Keys|item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
The Craw Summons is used to unlock the door inside the [[Craw Lake]] house on the far east side of [[Greymoor]], granting access to the [[Greymoor#Court_of_Craws|Court of Craws]]. 

{{Gallery
|Image1=Mapshot SS Craw Summons 01.png!Location of the house in Craw Lake
|Image2=Screenshot SS Craw Summons 01.png!The Craw Lake house
|Image3=Screenshot SS Craw Summons 02.png!Door inside the house
|Image4=Screenshot SS Craw Summons 04.png!Hornet giving the summons
}}

== How To Acquire ==
To receive the Craw Summons, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] must have reached [[Act 3]], completed the <i>[[SEEK: Awaiting the End]]</i> [[Objectives|objective]], and hit the lever inside the Craw house on [[Craw Lake]]. 

Once these things are done, there is a 20% chance Hornet receives the Summons every time she rests at certain Benches in [[Bellhart]], [[Bilewater]], [[Far Fields]], [[Shellwood]], [[Sinner's Road]], and [[Wisp Thicket]]. If the Summons does not appear, she must leave the room (or the [[Save Data (Silksong)|save profile]] must be reloaded) before the chance can be rolled again.

Once [[Silk Soar]] is obtained, the chance is raised to 25%, and each [[Old Hearts|Old Heart]] that is taken increases the chance by another 5%. The [[Everbloom]] also adds 5%, totalling to a maximum 50% chance to receive the Summons when resting at an applicable Bench once all of these [[Objectives|objective]] items are obtained.<ref group=Source>FSM <code>craw_summons_spawn_check</code> in <code>fsmtemplates_assets_shared.bundle</code>, FSM <code>craw_court_summons_pin</code> only exists in certain scenes with benches.</ref>

The following [[Bench (Silksong)|benches]] can receive the Craw Summons. [[Greymoor]] does not have a bench that can receive the Summons.
